pages.title: Metastasis Ward
pages.text: A ward against Metastasis, the Tumour Hydra's bite, which hides from any plain ward. Use it on yourself: held safe for three in-game days. Renew it while more than half of that is left and the imprint overloads instead. Made in the Clonal Selector.
Made in $(item)Clonal Selector$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Affinity Maturation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Lasting Metastasis Ward.
